text: This staff report is about a matter for which Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install an accessible loading zone on the north side of Innes Avenue, between a point 38 metres west of Caledonia Road and a point 11 metres further west. The loading zone will operate between the hours of 7:30 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, to provide curb side access for Wheel-Trans.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate from 7:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Innes Avenue, between a point 38 metres west of Caledonia Road and a point 11 metres further west.
